request.title: Prove the Laurent expansion of the S-local zeta germ (Ch07 Sec1a sweep)
request.body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/Ch07_SchauderBasesZeta/Sec1a.lean`.

Closes #4036

**Proved:** `sLocalZLaurentCoeff_hasLaurentSeries` (Definition 7.1.2.1, p. 316). It is not a split, and no statement changed.

Approach: three `private theorem`s directly above the declaration.
- `…_chart`: every S-local quasi-character `c` is a unitary chart `chartₛ(χ) s₀`, so `twistₛ c z = chartₛ(χ) (s₀ + z)`. This copies the private `exists_unitary_norm_chart` / `exists_sLocal_chart` argument of Ch03 Sec3b. With it, the germ is meromorphic at 0 by `sLocalIdelicZFunction_meromorphic`.
- `…_circleIntegral`: suppose `g = z^(-N) h` with `h` holomorphic on a closed disc. Then on every smaller circle, `∮ g z / z^(k+1) / 2πi` is the Cauchy coefficient of `h` at `k+N` (or 0 when `k < -N`). This uses `cauchyPowerSeries_apply`, uniqueness of power series, and Cauchy–Goursat.
- `…_of_meromorphicAt`: for any germ meromorphic at 0, the residue coefficients `complexResidue (g z / z^(k+1)) 0` form a `HasVectorLaurentSeriesAt` expansion. The partial sums are `z^(-N)` times the partial sums of the Taylor series, which converge uniformly on compact subsets of the punctured disc.

The PR adds one import of a Mathlib module, `Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.ProperSpace.Lemmas` (for `exists_pos_lt_subset_ball`).

Earlier attempts on this issue said the proof was blocked because `sLocalIdelicZFunction` carries `sorryAx`. Per prover.md, that is not a blocker.

`#print axioms RiemannMasullo.sLocalZLaurentCoeff_hasLaurentSeries`: `[propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. The `sorryAx` comes only from unproved upstream declarations behind `sLocalIdelicZFunction`. The only `sorry`s left in the file are the untouched #4037 and #4038.

Checks run:
- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch07_SchauderBasesZeta.Sec1a`: passes, about 5 s for the module.
- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch07_SchauderBasesZeta.Sec1a_Printed RiemannMasullo.Ch07_SchauderBasesZeta.Sec1b`: passes. These are the direct importers. The full `lake build` was not run in this sandbox.
- `scripts/lint.sh`: ok.
- `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` on before/after signature files of the module (from `scripts/Signatures.lean`): no changes.

#4037 and #4038 are released with notes.
